# MyTestType

> MyTestType is a Korean cultural entertainment service with four public experiences: AI Past-Life Character, AI Face Reading, AI Palm Reading, and K-Shaman AI Saju.

## Public experiences

- [AI Past-Life Character Test](https://mytesttype.com/): Uses a submitted photo to create a cultural, entertainment-oriented past-life character result.
- [AI Face Reading](https://mytesttype.com/gwansang/): Uses a submitted photo to present cultural, entertainment-oriented observations about facial features and impressions.
- [AI Palm Reading](https://mytesttype.com/palm-reading/): Uses a submitted palm photo to present cultural, entertainment-oriented observations about traditional palm-reading symbols.
- [K-Shaman AI Saju](https://mytesttype.com/k-shaman/): Uses birth date and birth time as inputs to present cultural, entertainment-oriented Saju guidance about tendencies and everyday behavior patterns.

## Scope and safety

- Results are cultural and entertainment-oriented guidance.
- Results do not definitively predict the future or replace medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice.
- All four experiences are publicly available. Results are not factual claims about a person's identity, health, future, wealth, or relationships.
